source_cn:
文森特是世代服务于威瑟尔家族的管家，每一任都会使用这个名字，至今已是第三十七任。
这一任文森特是窥秘人途径，习惯随身带书，保持阅读和思考的习惯。
他虔心阅读时，一个声音悄悄钻入他的脑海：
“知识就是力量……只要拥有力量……就能拥有一切……”
不知何时，书上的字变形扭曲，化为一个神秘的图案。
“知识组成的……皇冠……”
“知识能守护庄园……能避免当年的悲剧重演……”
文森特怔怔地合上书，心中迅速出现了一个计划。
他要找到知识组成的皇冠，他要获得知识的梦乡。
他要拼尽一切力量守护庄园，直到天穹倒转、群星坠落，无穷的知识走向尽头。
ref_en:
Vincent is the butler who has served the Wetherell family for generations; every successor uses this name, and he is now the thirty-seventh. 
 This Vincent is of the Mystery Pryer pathway, accustomed to carrying books with him and maintaining the habit of reading and thinking. 
 When he was reading devoutly, a voice quietly crept into his mind: 
 "Knowledge is Power... As long as you have power... you can have everything..." 
 At some point, the words on the book deformed and twisted, turning into a mysterious pattern. 
 "A crown... made of knowledge..." 
 "Knowledge can guard the manor... can prevent the tragedy of that year from repeating..." 
 Vincent closed the book in a daze, and a plan quickly appeared in his heart. 
 He wanted to find the crown made of knowledge; he wanted to obtain the dreamland of knowledge. 
 He wanted to use all his power to guard the manor until the sky turned upside down, the stars fell, and the infinite knowledge came to an end.

ref_en:
%s, long time no see: 
      I heard about your recent arduous battle with the Dancing King Baboon Brother. You've worked hard; you have always been very diligent. Susie and I have gathered some intelligence regarding the Dancing King Baboon Brother, and I hope it proves helpful: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302110">Records of the Dancing King Baboon Brother</>
      The fate you bear is filled with unknowns and dangers; even we cannot pierce through the mist and mysteries surrounding you. Perhaps more perilous situations and greater crises await us in the future. We all need to become stronger to protect ourselves and the things we cherish. But when you are exhausted, you are always welcome to come to the Fate Café for a seat. I have some excellent black tea and pastries here that you might enjoy. In your spare time, feel free to come chat with Susie and me to calm your mind; everything will be alright.

source_cn: 萨斯利尔身上的血肉和阴影”斗篷”同时膨胀了起来。砰！洛薇雅崩溃的身体被弹飞了出去，摔在了地上，而那属于她的阴影被直接撕碎，化成一片片虚幻的轻纱缓缓飘落。一道道缭绕着神圣火焰的光芒接连落下，击在了洛薇雅的身上，泯灭着她的灵魂，净化着她的血肉。洛薇雅的气息急速消散，淡灰的眼眸飞快失去了神采。她崩溃成一团血肉的身体蜷缩了起来，用那一条条没有皮肤的，满是鲜红黏液的手臂将那个乳白色的，偏大型的人类头骨紧紧抱”胸前”，压到了身下。炽烈的”阳光”照射中，神圣的火焰燃烧里，洛薇雅保持着这个姿态，不让自己有丝毫的动弹，不让那个人类头骨显露出来，受到伤害。又是一道光柱煊赫击落，洛薇雅的身体忍不住弹了一下，但还是剧烈颤抖着蜷缩于那里。最终，这团扭曲的，恶心的，蠕动的血肉停止了一切活动，死死地覆盖在那个人类头骨表面黯淡无光破败
ref_en: The flesh and the shadow "cloak" on Sasrir's body expanded simultaneously. Bang! Lovia's collapsing body was sent flying, crashing to the ground. The shadow that belonged to her was torn directly to shreds, turning into fragments of illusory gauze that drifted down slowly. Beams of light wreathed in holy flames descended one after another, striking Lovia's body, annihilating her soul and purifying her flesh. Lovia's aura dissipated rapidly, and her pale gray eyes quickly lost their luster. Her body, which had collapsed into a mass of flesh, curled up, using those skinless arms covered in bright red mucus to tightly hug that milky-white, oversized human skull to her "chest," pressing it beneath her. Amidst the scorching "sunlight" and the burning holy flames, Lovia maintained this posture, not allowing herself to move in the slightest, preventing that human skull from being exposed and harmed. Another brilliant pillar of light struck down, and Lovia's body couldn't help but jerk, but she still curled up there, trembling violently. Finally, this twisted, disgusting, writhing mass of flesh ceased all activity, dead and covering the dull, dilapidated surface of that human skull.

<Assistant_Title1>人脉许愿</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
在<Assistant_System>菜单-人脉-结交人脉</>界面的常驻结交活动中，点击视频左下方许愿按钮可进入许愿界面。
<Assistant_Property2>许愿</>指定人脉后，可提升结交时获得对应人脉的概率。
<Assistant_Title2>许愿规则：</>
可许愿的人脉为可结交的传说人脉。
许愿后，获得传说人脉时，获取许愿目标的概率提高到<Assistant_Property1>80%</>。如果获得的传说人脉不是许愿目标，那下次获得的传说人脉必定为许愿目标。
常驻结交中，<Assistant_Property1>每周</>可以生效<Assistant_Property1>2次</>许愿效果，周一重置。每当结交人脉<Assistant_Property1>110次</>，可额外获得一次许愿次数。该次数不会被重置，且消耗优先级低于每周重置的次数。
许愿一位人脉后，若误操作选错许愿目标，可点击取消许愿按钮取消许愿。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[人脉]|550}，{SendAnswer:[关系]|551}，{SendAnswer:[结交人脉]|554}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Connection Wishing</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Explanation: </>
In the permanent connection event in the <Assistant_System>Menu - Connections - Make Connections</> interface, click the wish button at the bottom left of the video to enter the wishing interface. 
<Assistant_Property2>Wishing </> for a specific connection can increase the probability of obtaining that connection when making connections. 
<Assistant_Title2>Wishing Rules: </>
Connections that can be wished for are legendary connections that can be made. 
After wishing, when you obtain a legendary connection, the probability of getting the wished target increases to <Assistant_Property1>80%</>. If the legendary connection obtained is not the wished target, the next legendary connection obtained is guaranteed to be the wished target. 
In permanent connections, you can have <Assistant_Property1>2</> wish effects take effect <Assistant_Property1>per week</>, resetting on Monday. Every time you make <Assistant_Property1>110</> connections, you can obtain one additional wish attempt. This count will not be reset, and its consumption priority is lower than the weekly reset attempts. 
After wishing for a connection, if you accidentally select the wrong target, you can click the cancel wish button to cancel the wish. 
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Connections]|550}, {SendAnswer:[Relationships]|551}, {SendAnswer:[Make Connections]|554}

source_cn:
比煤灰更厚重的黑夜里，唯有工厂区的酒馆保持着喧闹。
大笑、咳嗽、无休止的抱怨……巡警咒骂着，像避开麻烦一样绕过噪音，走向远处的街区。
“他们走了。”娜塔放下帘子，向清醒的人们宣告。
工人们正把布条铺在地上，用木炭条写着明天要举的口号：“要工资”“要休息”“要像人一样生活”，孩子挤在角落，分装干粮与小瓶酒精。烛火昏暗，映出一双双发亮的眼睛。
“等到明天，我们就能拿回应得的报酬了吗？”年长的工人问。
“等到明天，我们就能保证十小时的休息吗？”年幼的孩子问。
“……抱歉，我无法向你们担保。”娜塔沉默了。
“我们的旗帜会倒下，但我们前进的每一步，都会在地上留下痕迹。”
或许，远在另一个时代，已经有人沿着它走到天亮。
ref_en:
In the night, heavier than coal dust, only the taverns in the factory district remained noisy. 
Laughter, coughing, endless complaints... The patrolmen cursed, bypassing the noise as if avoiding trouble, heading toward the distant blocks. 
"They're gone," Nata lowered the curtain and announced to the sober people. 
The workers were laying cloth strips on the ground, using charcoal sticks to write the slogans they would raise tomorrow: "We want wages," "We want rest," "We want to live like human beings." Children huddled in the corner, dividing dry rations and small bottles of alcohol. The candlelight was dim, reflecting pairs of shining eyes. 
"By tomorrow, will we be able to get the pay we deserve?" an older worker asked. 
"By tomorrow, will we be able to guarantee ten hours of rest?" a young child asked. 
"...Sorry, I cannot guarantee that for you," Nata fell silent. 
"Our flags may fall, but every step we take forward will leave a mark on the ground." 
Perhaps, far away in another era, someone has already followed it until dawn.

source_cn: 世代效忠威瑟尔家族的文森特，在庄园遇袭之夜启动了先祖铠甲，铠甲却被未知污染侵蚀，反过来屠尽了庄园。绝望中，他发现海伦娜还活着。她是唯一的幸存者，她不知道铠甲失控的真相。文森特咽下了坦白与忏悔，发誓用余生弥补。他将铠甲封锁，独自追查仇敌与污染源头，为获取力量不择手段。直到某人告诉他“知识皇冠”的存在，他看见了希望。\n“知识就是力量。”
ref_en: Vincent, who had served the Wetherell family for generations, activated the Ancestor Armor on the night the manor was attacked, but the armor was eroded by unknown corruption and turned to slaughter the manor in return. In despair, he discovered that Helena was still alive. She was the only survivor, and she did not know the truth about the armor's loss of control. Vincent swallowed his confession and repentance, vowing to spend the rest of his life making amends. He sealed the armor and pursued the enemies and the source of the corruption alone, stopping at nothing to gain power. Until someone told him about the existence of the 'Crown of Knowledge,' he saw hope. \n "Knowledge is Power."

source_cn:
——在那个平行世界里，奥黛丽和苏茜合作解决了佛尔思同伴的案件。

      贝克兰德，霍尔家的花园。奥黛丽坐在吊椅上，阳光透过藤蔓洒下斑驳的光影。
      几天前，佛尔思·沃尔来访时的神情又浮现在她眼前。那位气质慵懒的作家露出郑重的神色：“我有位同伴被关入了监狱，正等待着最后的审判，我希望你们能够救她出来，无论用什么办法。”
      而同行的格莱林特子爵派人咨询了熟悉的大律师，对方说有把握只是轻判，但无罪辩护的难度很高，除非当事人能拿到精神有问题或者心智发育不健全的医疗证明……
      奥黛丽记得自己当时答应了佛尔思会认真考虑。作家小姐离开时还回头看了一眼，淡蓝色的眼睛里藏着期待。
      “医疗证明……”奥黛丽轻声自语，眉头微蹙。她不是没想过用霍尔家的影响力去疏通，但那会暴露她和佛尔思、休之间的关系。况且，那位黑帮头目虽然出具了原谅声明，严重伤害的案件却依然可能被起诉。
      身旁趴着的苏茜竖起耳朵，用只有奥黛丽能听见的声音小声说：“那个黑帮头目，还在医院里？”
      奥黛丽低头看她，目光微动。
      “我去试一试。”苏茜摇了摇尾巴提议道。
      当天夜里，苏茜悄悄潜入病房。她用“观众”的能力温和地引导那位“体面的绅士”回忆——对方终于记起，是自己先动了手，休只是自卫。醒来后，他主动向检察官更正了证词。
      几天后，休被无罪释放。佛尔思来霍尔家道谢时，感慨“检察官突然发现了新证据，运气真好”。
      奥黛丽微笑着点头：“是啊，运气真好。”
      苏茜趴在她脚边，尾巴拍打着地毯，心满意足。
ref_en:
—In that parallel world, Audrey and Susie worked together to solve the case involving Fors's companion. 

      Backlund, the Hall family garden. Audrey sat on a hanging chair, sunlight casting dappled light and shadows through the vines. 
      A few days ago, the expression on Fors Wall's face when she visited appeared in her mind again. That lazy-tempered writer had shown a solemn look: "I have a companion who has been thrown into prison and is waiting for the final verdict. I hope you can save her, no matter what method you use." 
      And the accompanying Viscount Glaint had sent someone to consult a well-known lawyer, who said there was a chance for a light sentence, but an acquittal was very difficult unless the defendant could obtain a medical certificate stating they had mental issues or were mentally underdeveloped... 
      Audrey remembered that she had promised Fors she would consider it carefully. When the writer left, she had looked back, anticipation hidden in her light blue eyes. 
      "Medical certificate..." Audrey whispered to herself, her brows slightly furrowed. It wasn't that she hadn't thought about using the Hall family's influence to pull strings, but that would expose her relationship with Fors and Xio. Moreover, although the gang leader had issued a statement of forgiveness, the case of grievous injury could still be prosecuted. 
      Susie, lying beside her, pricked up her ears and whispered in a voice only Audrey could hear: "That gang leader, is he still in the hospital?" 
      Audrey looked down at her, her gaze flickering. 
      "I'll go give it a try," Susie suggested, wagging her tail. 
      That night, Susie quietly snuck into the hospital room. She used her Spectator ability to gently guide the "decent gentleman" to recall—the other party finally remembered that he had struck first and that Xio was only acting in self-defense. After waking up, he took the initiative to correct his testimony to the prosecutor. 
      A few days later, Xio was acquitted. When Fors came to the Hall residence to thank her, she sighed, "The prosecutor suddenly found new evidence; what good luck." 
      Audrey smiled and nodded: "Yes, what good luck." 
      Susie lay at her feet, her tail thumping against the carpet, feeling satisfied.

<Yellow>生命能量</>：携带者每隔<Yellow>20秒</>获得1点生命能量，持有上限为3点。携带者对自身或友方单位造成的累计有效治疗超过自身生命值上限的<Yellow>50%</>时，消耗1点生命能量，对目标附加3层<Yellow>蓬勃生长</>效果，持续10秒，并获得1枚<Yellow>生命之种</>，持有上限为3枚。

<Yellow>生命之种</>：携带者受到伤害时，如果生命值低于<Yellow>50%</>，则自动消耗1枚生命之种，固定恢复<Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=1?32%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=2?40%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=3?48%}</>上限的生命值。
ref_en:
<Yellow>Life Energy</>: The bearer gains 1 point of Life Energy every <Yellow>20 seconds</>, with a maximum capacity of 3 points. When the cumulative effective healing dealt by the bearer to themselves or friendly units exceeds <Yellow>50%</> of their own maximum HP, 1 point of Life Energy is consumed to apply 3 stacks of <Yellow>Flourishing Growth</> to the target for 10 seconds, and the bearer gains 1 <Yellow>Seed of Life</>, with a maximum capacity of 3 seeds. 

<Yellow>Flourishing Growth</>: When HP is not full, 1 stack is consumed per second to restore <Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=1?*d}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=2?*d}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=3?*d}</> HP. 
<Yellow>Seed of Life</>: When the bearer takes damage and their HP is below <Yellow>50%</>, 1 Seed of Life is automatically consumed to restore a fixed amount of <Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=1?32%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=2?40%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085006)=3?48%}</> of their maximum HP.

<Assistant_Title1>秘偶许愿</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
1、在乌托邦剧院进行<Assistant_Property1>秘偶抽选</>时，可以设置许愿秘偶。
2、许愿后，戏台<Assistant_Property1>刷新</>新一批秘偶时，如果出现与许愿秘偶<Assistant_Property1>同品质</>的秘偶，有<Assistant_Red>80%</>的概率是许愿秘偶。如果本次没有出现，则下一次<Assistant_Red>必定</>是许愿秘偶。
3、许愿没有生效次数的限制，可以随时更换。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[获取秘偶]|536}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Marionette Wish</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </>
1. When performing <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Selection</> at the Utopia Theater, you can set a Wish Marionette.
2. After wishing, when the stage <Assistant_Property1>refreshes</> a new batch of marionettes, if a marionette of the <Assistant_Property1>same quality</> as the Wish Marionette appears, there is an <Assistant_Red>80%</> chance it will be the Wish Marionette. If it does not appear this time, the next time is <Assistant_Red>guaranteed</> to be the Wish Marionette.
3. There is no limit to the number of times you can wish, and you can change it at any time.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Obtain Marionette]|536}

source_cn:
安德鲁是一条乖狗狗，很喜欢苹果。
管家爷爷教会了安德鲁很多事：起立、坐下、握手、转圈……每次安德鲁做对了，都会得到一个鲜红的大苹果。
管家爷爷教过的指令里，最重要的一条是“守护家园”。
接到这个指令后，安德鲁开始发生一些变化。
“汪！汪汪！”
——人，安德鲁会守护好家园的！
“呜……呜汪！汪……”
——人，安德鲁不喜欢那些藤蔓，好奇怪的力量……安德鲁好难受，安德鲁想被摸头……
“嗷呜——嗷呜——”
——人，你看起来好小啊……原来安德鲁、安德鲁变大了。这样就能守护家园了……对么……
ref_en:
Andrew is a good dog who loves apples very much. 
 Grandpa Butler taught Andrew many things: stand up, sit down, shake hands, roll over... Every time Andrew did it right, he would get a bright red apple. 
 Among the commands Grandpa Butler taught, the most important one was "Guard the home." 
 After receiving this command, Andrew began to undergo some changes. 
 "Woof! Woof woof!" 
 —Human, Andrew will guard the home well! 
 "Woo... woo woof! Woof..." 
 —Human, Andrew doesn't like those vines, such strange power... Andrew feels so uncomfortable, Andrew wants to be petted... 
 "Awoo—awoo—" 
 —Human, you look so small... So Andrew, Andrew has grown bigger. This way, I can guard the home... right...

<Assistant_Title1>【End-Time Hunt】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description:</><Assistant_System>End-Time Hunt</> is a <Assistant_Property1>500-player free-for-all</> field gameplay taking place in the <Assistant_Red>City of Dragon Hunting</>. You can defeat supernatural creatures or hostile players to obtain <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> and Rank Points.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective:</>Submit <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> to the <Assistant_System>Hunting Butler</> to advance the hunting progress and unlock stage rewards. Scarlet Relics are only effective within the City of Dragon Hunting and will be automatically invalidated and cleared upon leaving.
<Assistant_Title2>Hunting Time:</>The gameplay is open all day; daily <Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</> is Hunting Time, with additional sessions on Saturday and Sunday from <Assistant_Red>14:00—15:00</>. During Hunting Time, the amount of Rank Points involved in killing or being killed is doubled.
<Assistant_Title2>Royal City Event:</>10 minutes after the start of the Friday night Hunting Time, i.e., <Assistant_Red>19:10</>, the Dragon - Projection will refresh in the center of the Royal City; outside of Friday night sessions, the Royal City Guardian will refresh 10 minutes after the start of other Hunting Times.
<Assistant_Title2>Team Settlement:</>The killer and up to 29 team members who meet the assist conditions participate in the reward settlement. Scarlet Relics are distributed equally among the participants, with remainders prioritized to the killer, and the rest randomly distributed among other participants.
<Assistant_Title2>Plunder Rules:</>The more fragments displayed above a player's head, the higher the proportion of Scarlet Relics that can be plundered; for every 500 fragments increased, the plunder proportion increases accordingly.
<Assistant_Title2>Rank Rules:</>When your rank is below <Assistant_Red>Count Tier 1</>, you will not lose Rank Points when killed. Rank Points obtained by killing players will be reduced according to rules during 01:00—08:00 daily and when repeatedly killing the same target within a short period.
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Method:</>{JumpToUI:[前往终末猎杀]|1250342}

source_cn: ClampSpeed(min=1.0, max=1.3)，代表将速度被修正的话，限制其最小值和最大值，即人物速度不能小于默认值的100%，也不能大于130%\n同时，和战斗常常量表的SPEED_RATE_LOWER_LIMIT同时生效，两者取更严格的。只支持一层，后面来的直接把前面覆盖掉
ref_en: ClampSpeed(min=1.0, max=1.3), meaning if speed is modified, its minimum and maximum values are restricted; i.e., character speed cannot be less than 100% of the default value, nor greater than 130%. \n Simultaneously, it takes effect with the combat constant SPEED_RATE_LOWER_LIMIT, with the stricter of the two being applied. Only supports one layer; subsequent ones overwrite the previous ones.

source_cn:
关于本品：
本品为针对灵体的专项封印器具，对怨灵、执念型恶灵及强负面灵性体均有显著效力。
价格不菲。效果对得起价格。


负面反应说明：
购入者注视镜面时，可能出现以下感受：
持续的"吸引感"，难以移开视线
无由来的落泪冲动
想要打破镜子的念头
以上均属正常。


使用方法
封印步骤：
对准目标
确保对方身影被镜面完整照到
保持照射，持续时间越长，封印效果越稳定
目标被完全封入镜中空间后，其灵性将被持续消耗、削弱，无法自行逃逸


终结步骤：
以魔镐敲击镜面，恶灵将被削弱力量后勾出，使用者可自行选择割喉亦或砍下其头部，使之被永久消灭。


静置与保管
不使用时，建议镜面朝内、背面朝外放置，或以厚布完全遮盖。


附：
请勿将其在无遮蔽状态下过夜放置。
若已如此放置，次日请检查镜框内侧银片。
若发现划痕——请确认划痕的方向。
若为由外向内，属正常磨损。
若为由里向外，请将镜面立即翻转，背面朝外，随后自行做仪式驱魔、净化处理。
ref_en:
About this product:
This is a specialized sealing apparatus for spirits, highly effective against wraiths, obsession-type evil spirits, and entities with strong negative spirituality.
It is not cheap. The effect is worth the price.


Negative Reaction Description:
When the purchaser gazes into the mirror surface, they may experience the following:
A continuous 'sense of attraction,' making it difficult to look away
A sudden, inexplicable urge to weep
The thought of wanting to break the mirror
All of the above are normal.


Usage Instructions
Sealing Steps:
Aim at the target
Ensure the target's figure is fully reflected in the mirror
Maintain the reflection; the longer the duration, the more stable the sealing effect
Once the target is completely sealed into the mirror space, its spirituality will be continuously consumed and weakened, making it unable to escape on its own


Finish Steps:
Strike the mirror surface with a magic pickaxe; the evil spirit will be weakened and drawn out. The user can then choose to slit its throat or decapitate it, causing it to be permanently destroyed.


Storage and Maintenance
When not in use, it is recommended to place the mirror face-in and back-out, or cover it completely with a thick cloth.


Appendix:
Do not leave it in an uncovered state overnight.
If it has been left this way, please check the silver foil on the inside of the mirror frame the next day.
If you find scratches—please check the direction of the scratches.
If they are from the outside in, it is normal wear and tear.
If they are from the inside out, please turn the mirror over immediately, back-out, and then perform your own ritual of exorcism and purification.

ref_en: A historical projection of the ancient battlefield from the Fourth Epoch, the <Highlight>City of Dragon Hunting</>.\n When the <Highlight>Black Emperor</> returned, the <Highlight>Night Emperor</> turned into a Justiciar with the help of a god, the <Highlight>Blood Emperor</> forcibly turned into a Red Priest at the cost of becoming half-mad, and the <Highlight>Underworld Emperor</>, who had been accumulating power in the Southern Continent, also sounded the horn of the Death god. With the four emperors gathered, only one could be the final winner, and a war capable of changing the world's situation began.\n Although the War of the Four Emperors of the Fourth Epoch has been buried in history, powerful energy remains on that ancient battlefield, and the entire battlefield is briefly reactivated at specific times. Each activation of the battlefield triggers a new shuffle, and clubs are randomly assigned to one of the four imperial factions to participate in this battle from the distant Fourth Epoch.

<InvDefault_HW>“如果你是来给我带来温暖的，那确实是我。”恢复了体温的戴莉在麋鹿的头顶蹦跶了几下，继续说道：“我叫戴莉， 你的名字是什么？”</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>戴莉这才注意到，麋鹿的角上挂着许多小木牌，上面写着“我叫邓恩”、我是森林的守护者”、“每天巡逻看谁需要帮助”……</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>“你叫邓恩，”戴莉轻声说，她听树洞里的松鼠一家提起过这头每到冬天就会失忆的麋鹿，曾一天给他们送了三次松子，“你是银雾森林的守护者。”</>
ref_en:
<InvDefault_HW>"If you've come to bring me warmth, then that is indeed me." Daly, having regained her body temperature, hopped a few times on the moose's head and continued, "My name is Daly. What is your name?"</>

　　<InvDefault_HW> "I am... I'm sorry, I have forgotten my name."</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>Only then did Daly notice that many small wooden plaques were hanging on the moose's antlers, with words written on them like "My name is Dunn," "I am the Guardian of the forest," "Patrol every day to see who needs help"...</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>"Your name is Dunn," Daly said softly. She had heard the squirrel family in the tree hole mention this moose that would lose its memory every winter, having once delivered pine nuts to them three times in a single day, "You are the Guardian of the Silver Mist Forest."</>

source_cn: 我成为了一位“通识者”，靠着魔药的力量，我竟然完整回想起了以前学过的知识，物理，化学，等等，等等。​\n　　不仅回想起，我还深刻地理解和掌握了它们，哈哈，这简直是为我这个异域来客量身定做的“职业”嘛，能最大化地发挥我的优势！不得不说，如果我以这样的状态回去，回到高三，一定能成为状元，要是再有更规范更深入的专业学习，科学家不算太困难的目标。​
ref_en: I became a "Savant." Relying on the power of the potion, I actually recalled all the knowledge I had learned before—physics, chemistry, and so on. \n Not only did I recall them, but I also deeply understood and mastered them. Haha, this is simply a "profession" tailor-made for an outsider like me; it maximizes my advantages! I must say, if I went back in this state, back to my senior year of high school, I would definitely become the top scholar. If I had more standardized and in-depth professional training, becoming a scientist wouldn't be too difficult a goal.

<Assistant_Title2>更换规则：</>
1. 原教团的行动值、等级、属性会保留，切回时可继续使用原进度。

<Assistant_Title1> [How to Change Covenants] </>
 After joining a Covenant, you can enter the process of changing Covenants in the Covenant interface. 

<Assistant_Title2> Change Rules: </>
 1. The Action Points, level, and attributes of the original Covenant will be retained, and you can continue to use the original progress when switching back. 
 2. You can switch directly if all Covenant levels are below 4; if any Covenant level is 4 or higher, there will be a 7x24 hour cooldown for switching. 

<Assistant_Title3> Recommended Searches: </> {SendAnswer: [Covenant Selection and Attribute Points] | 1274 }, {SendAnswer: [Covenant Level, Breakthrough, and Rewards] | 1277 }

source_cn:
1. <Highlight>家族申请表：</>每位未加入家族的非凡者可填写发布个人申请表寻找适合自己的家族，申请表在发布<Highlight>7天后</>或成功加入家族后将会自动撤下。
2. <Highlight>响应招募：</>未加入家族的非凡者，可选择自行发起或加入其他非凡者的响应招募，发起响应的非凡者默认成为<Highlight>家族首席</>。
3. <Highlight>创建家族：</>在响应招募阶段中，家族的响应人数达到<Highlight>3人及以上</>，即可创建家族，创建过程中首席可以调整家族名称和成员位次。
4. <Highlight>加入家族：</>当家族成员不满<Highlight>14人</>时，首席可发起家族招募。其他非凡者发起申请，并通过首席审核后，可直接加入家族。
ref_en:
1. <Highlight> Family Application Form: </> Any Beyonder not in a family can fill out and publish a personal application form to find a suitable family. The form will be automatically removed <Highlight> 7 days </> after publication or upon successfully joining a family. 
 2. <Highlight> Respond to Recruitment: </> Beyonders not in a family can choose to initiate or join another Beyonder's recruitment response. The Beyonder who initiates the response becomes the <Highlight> Family Chief </> by default. 
 3. <Highlight> Create a Family: </> During the recruitment response phase, once the family response count reaches <Highlight> 3 or more </>, you can create a family. During creation, the Chief can adjust the family name and member positions. 
 4. <Highlight> Join a Family: </> When a family has fewer than <Highlight> 14 members </>, the Chief can initiate family recruitment. Other Beyonders can apply, and upon approval by the Chief, they can join the family directly.

每件外观均拥有基础风尚度，玩家可通过消耗染色材料，染色并保存方案获得额外风尚度加成，方案中每消耗<Highlight>1</>个珊瑚染料获得<Highlight>10</>风尚度，每消耗<Highlight>1</>个虹光染料获得<Highlight>40</>风尚度，每消耗<Highlight>1</>个泡沫染膏获得<Highlight>20</>风尚度，每消耗一个神眷牌获得<Highlight>4000</>风尚度。系统将从该外观已保存的全部染色方案中，选取额外风尚度最高的<Highlight> 3 </>套，累加至基础风尚度之上，作为该外观的最终风尚度。

举例：
某件外观装备的基础风尚度为 <Highlight>800</>，玩家已在该外观下保存了 <Highlight>4 </>套染色方案，四套方案所提供的额外风尚度分别为 <Highlight>150、280、420、360</>。
系统将从这<Highlight> 4 </>套方案中选取额外风尚度最高的 <Highlight>3 </>套（即 420、360、280）结算，其余方案不参与计算。
因此，该外观的染色累计加成为 420 + 360 + 280 = 1060，最终总风尚度为基础风尚度 800 与染色累计加成 1060 相加，即 1860。

补充说明：
1. 新增或修改染色方案后，系统将自动选取最高的<Highlight> 3 </>套参与结算，更新此外观的风尚度。
2. 删除某套染色方案将同步移出结算队列，若删除的方案原本参与结算，则由剩余方案中次高者递补。
3. 若玩家未保存任何染色方案，则该外观仅显示基础风尚度。
ref_en:
Every cosmetic has a base Fashion Value. Players can consume dyeing materials to dye and save schemes to obtain additional Fashion Value bonuses. Each <Highlight>1</> Coral Dye consumed in a scheme grants <Highlight>10</> Fashion Value, each <Highlight>1</> Rainbow Dye grants <Highlight>40</> Fashion Value, each <Highlight>1</> Foam Dye grants <Highlight>20</> Fashion Value, and each Divine Favor Card consumed grants <Highlight>4000</> Fashion Value. The system will select the <Highlight> 3 </> schemes with the highest additional Fashion Value from all saved dyeing schemes for this cosmetic and add them to the base Fashion Value as the final Fashion Value of the cosmetic. 

Example: 
The base Fashion Value of a certain cosmetic equipment is <Highlight>800</>. The player has saved <Highlight>4 </> dyeing schemes for this cosmetic, and the additional Fashion Value provided by the four schemes are <Highlight>150, 280, 420, 360</>. 
The system will select the <Highlight> 3 </> schemes with the highest additional Fashion Value from these <Highlight> 4 </> schemes (i.e., 420, 360, 280) for settlement; the remaining schemes will not participate in the calculation. 
Therefore, the cumulative dyeing bonus for this cosmetic is 420 + 360 + 280 = 1060, and the final total Fashion Value is the base Fashion Value of 800 plus the cumulative dyeing bonus of 1060, which is 1860. 

Supplementary Notes: 
1. After adding or modifying a dyeing scheme, the system will automatically select the highest <Highlight> 3 </> schemes to participate in the settlement and update the Fashion Value of this cosmetic. 
2. Deleting a dyeing scheme will simultaneously remove it from the settlement queue. If the deleted scheme was originally participating in the settlement, it will be replaced by the next highest remaining scheme. 
3. If the player has not saved any dyeing schemes, the cosmetic will only display the base Fashion Value.

source_cn:
1345年4月12日 
第一次摸到父亲的工具。锤子比想象中沉，手抖得厉害，把银片敲变形了。

1345年8月3日 
学会了辨认红宝石和石榴石的区别。

1346年2月18日 
母亲咳嗽又重了。周薪涨到12苏勒，买了些润喉的草药。

1346年7月9日 
独立完成了一枚银戒指的抛光。主顾是个码头工人，给未婚妻的。

1347年3月15日 
正式成为匠人学徒。父亲说我手稳，适合吃这碗饭。

1347年11月2日 
学会了镶嵌月光石。父亲点头了。

1348年6月3日 
周薪涨到1镑5苏勒。母亲炖了肉汤。

1348年9月14日 
第一次接定制单。顾客要一枚带苹果花纹的胸针，说送给妻子。画了三遍草图才满意。

1349年1月20日 
整理铺子旧物，发现一张泛黄的家谱图。有些名字被涂掉了。

1349年3月8日 
母亲的药粉快吃完了。这周多接些修活的单子。

1349年6月28日 
收到了一本奇怪的笔记。翻开第一页，那些符号……好像在哪里见过。
ref_en:
April 12, 1345 
 First time touching father's tools. The hammer was heavier than expected, my hand shook so much I deformed the silver sheet. 

 August 3, 1345 
 Learned to distinguish between rubies and garnets. 

 February 18, 1346 
 Mother's cough worsened. Weekly wage rose to 12 sous, bought some throat-soothing herbs. 

 July 9, 1346 
 Independently finished polishing a silver ring. The client was a dock worker, for his fiancée. 

 March 15, 1347 
 Officially became a craftsman's apprentice. Father said my hands are steady, suitable for this trade. 

 November 2, 1347 
 Learned to set moonstones. Father nodded. 

 June 3, 1348 
 Weekly wage rose to 1 pound 5 sous. Mother made meat stew. 

 September 14, 1348 
 First custom order. Customer wanted a brooch with an apple pattern, said it was for his wife. Drew the sketch three times before he was satisfied. 

 January 20, 1349 
 Sorting through old items in the shop, found a yellowed family tree. Some names were crossed out. 

 March 8, 1349 
 Mother's herbal powder is almost gone. Need to take more repair jobs this week. 

 June 28, 1349 
 Received a strange notebook. Opened the first page, those symbols... I feel like I've seen them somewhere.
